title: One-variable Cauchy formula on a circle
statement:
Work over $\mathbf C$ [def-weil-field]. Let $c\in\mathbf C$, let $R>0$, and let $h:\mathbf C\to\mathbf C$ be continuous on $\{\zeta:|\zeta-c|\leq R\}$ and complex differentiable at every point of $\{\zeta:|\zeta-c|<R\}$. Then for every $z$ with $|z-c|<R$,
$$\frac{1}{2\pi i}\int_{|\zeta-c|=R}\frac{h(\zeta)}{\zeta-z}\,d\zeta=h(z),$$
where the circle is positively oriented, parametrized by $\zeta=c+Re^{it}$ for $0\leq t\leq2\pi$.
